OPTIVAULT — AI PERSONAL FINANCIAL ADVISOR & SMART BUDGETING APP

Take control of your money with Optivault, the powerful AI personal financial advisor and all-in-one budgeting app built to help you track expenses, plan budgets, grow savings, and build wealth effortlessly.

Whether you need a smarter budget planner, a real-time expense tracker, or an intelligent money manager, Optivault brings everything together in one secure finance app.

AI PERSONAL FINANCIAL ADVISOR
Your money, guided by AI.

• Conversational AI assistant answers your finance questions 24/7
• Personalized budgeting and saving tips based on your habits
• Smart insights to improve cash flow and reduce overspending
• AI recommendations adapt as your goals and spending change
• A true AI financial advisor in your pocket

SMART BUDGETING & BUDGET PLANNER
Build a budget that actually works.

• AI creates your custom budget in minutes
• Flexible categories for full control
• Budget tracker with real-time progress bars
• Alerts before you overspend
• Set and track saving goals easily

A simple yet powerful budgeting app and budget planner for beginners and experts.

EXPENSE & MONEY TRACKER
Track every dollar automatically.

• Secure bank and card sync with live updates
• Automatic transaction categorization
• Expense tracker shows where your money goes
• Spending charts reveal patterns and subscriptions
• Smart alerts for big purchases and recurring bills

Use Optivault as your daily expense tracker, spending tracker, and money tracker.

INVESTMENT & NET WORTH TRACKER
Grow and manage your wealth.

• Track stocks, ETFs, crypto, and retirement accounts
• Unified investment tracker dashboard
• Net worth tracking over time
• Market trends and price alerts
• Long-term financial planning tools

Your complete investment app and wealth manager.

SECURE & PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your data is always protected.

• Bank-level 256-bit encryption
• Read-only access to your accounts
• Face ID, Touch ID, and PIN protection
• Your data is never sold

A finance app you can trust.

WHY OPTIVAULT?

• All-in-one budgeting app, expense tracker, and AI financial advisor
• Fast setup with no manual imports
• Smart automation saves time
• Built for US banks with Plaid integration
• Perfect for stress-free money management

Optivault is the smarter way to manage money.

Download Optivault today and start your free 7-day trial.
Master your money with AI.
